_about: Character voices. Spoken lines come from Google Gemini TTS (native Spanish); MiMo TTS was tested on 2026-10-13 and its preset voices do not pronounce Spanish intelligibly, so it is not used for speech. Gemini prebuilt voice names: Kore, Puck, Charon, Aoede, Leda, Zephyr, Sulafat, Achird, Fenrir, Orus, ... `eleven` is the ElevenLabs voice name used through LLM Gateway (eleven-v3, language always es) for the accounts in data/spanish-gateway-users.json.
